description: Referring sites (the host only: Motif never keeps the linking page) ranked by the net revenue, paying customers and signups of the people they first brought in the range, with 35 days of daily visits each. status lost means it sent visits in the 28 days before the last 7 and none since; stalled means people still come but stopped signing up. Search engines, ads and direct are not links. Same from/to/time_zone/currency as analytics_snapshot.

from.description: inclusive start YYYY-MM-DD; default last 60 days

period.description: named window instead of from/to: today, yesterday, 7d, 28d, 30d, 90d, 365d (each ends today), this_month, or last_month

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website

name: paying_links
title: Links that pay
